q0001.s: In the supplied issue, which city wins the Swachh Vayu category below 3 lakh population?
q0001.f: Kalinganagar belongs to the below-3-lakh band. Lucknow wins above 10 lakh and Rourkela wins 3-10 lakh; the category is the decisive detail. (PDF p. 5; issue context.)

q0002.s: Which Census 2027 mascot-role pair is reported correctly?
q0002.f: Pragati represents the female enumerator; Vikas represents the male enumerator. The source pairs two names with two roles. (PDF p. 6; issue context.)

q0003.s: What is the Mission for Cotton Productivity outlay in the issue?
q0003.f: The mission's stated outlay is ₹5,659.22 crore. ₹28,840 crore is associated with Modified UDAN; ₹53,428 crore is the welfare-programme figure. (PDF p. 6; issue context.)

q0004.s: What distance accompanies Neeraj Chopra's reported Lausanne 2026 second place?
q0004.f: The result is 88.05 metres. Metres measure the javelin throw; keep the reported second place and Lausanne 2026 context with the distance. (PDF p. 17; issue context.)

q0005.s: Which pair correctly separates UDAN's launch and first flight?
q0005.f: The source launches the scheme on 21 October 2016 and dates its first Shimla-Delhi flight to April 2017. Launch and first operation are different events. (PDF p. 18; issue context.)

q0006.s: From which RTI milestone does the issue count 21 years in October 2026?
q0006.f: The anniversary is of full implementation on 12 October 2005. Assent was earlier, on 15 June 2005. (PDF p. 19; issue context.)

q0007.s: Which direction and river system fit the Ken-Betwa project?
o: Ken to Betwa; both Yamuna tributaries
Betwa to Ken; both Godavari tributaries
Ken to Ganga; both Narmada tributaries
Betwa to Mahanadi; both coastal rivers
q0007.f: The project seeks to transfer surplus Ken basin water towards the water-deficit Betwa basin. Both rivers are Yamuna tributaries, serving Bundelkhand in MP and UP. (PDF p. 38; issue context.)

q0008.s: Which Census statement correctly separates the two phases?
o: Population Enumeration records only housing assets
Houselisting and Population Enumeration are the same task
Houselisting records homes and amenities; Population Enumeration records people's characteristics
q0008.f: Houselisting records housing conditions, amenities and assets; Population Enumeration records demography, literacy, migration and other population characteristics. The two phases serve different purposes. (PDF p. 49; issue context.)

q0009.s: Which country belongs to EFTA in the source's four-member list?
q0009.f: Norway is listed with Iceland, Liechtenstein and Switzerland. Do not substitute a nearby European country for a member. (PDF p. 53; issue context.)

q0010.s: What does 1 October 2025 mark in the TEPA timeline?
q0010.f: The agreement was signed on 10 March 2024 and entered into force on 1 October 2025. EFTA itself was established in 1960. (PDF p. 53; issue context.)

q0011.s: Which BRICS statement preserves the supplied summit account?
o: A common BRICS currency was launched
Partner countries are all full members
Payment interoperability continued; no common currency was announced
q0011.f: The source explicitly distinguishes payment/local-currency cooperation from a common currency and full members from partners. (PDF p. 75; issue context.)

q0012.s: Which report-publisher pair is correct in the PDF summary?
q0012.f: The summary pairs HDR with UNDP and GII with WIPO. Publisher is a separate field from India's rank and the report's edition year. (PDF p. 86; issue context.)

q0013.s: Which combination equals the source's approved 60.72% IDBI stake sale?
q0013.f: The stakes being sold are 30.48% from Government and 30.24% from LIC. Their earlier holdings and approximate residual holdings describe different stages. (PDF p. 87; issue context.)

q0014.s: The new GDP series described in the issue uses which base year?
q0014.f: The issue identifies 2022-23 as the new base, replacing 2011-12. A base year is different from the year whose growth is estimated. (PDF p. 91; issue context.)

q0015.s: Which figure is the States' vertical tax-devolution share in the 16th FC article?
q0015.f: 41% is the vertical share. 42.5% and 17.5% are separate horizontal criteria weights, while all horizontal weights sum to 100%. (PDF p. 93; issue context.)

q0016.s: Which statement correctly labels the issue's Union fiscal-deficit figure?
q0016.f: The source gives 4.3% of GDP for the Centre's FY 2026-27 Budget Estimate and 4.4% for FY 2025-26 Revised Estimate. Keep the unit and status. (PDF p. 113; issue context.)

q0017.s: From which moon does the issue's MMX mission seek to return material?
q0017.f: MMX studies Phobos and Deimos, but the stated sample-return target is Phobos, with at least 10 grams. (PDF p. 121; issue context.)

q0018.s: Which GAGAN developer pair is given in the source?
o: ISRO and Airports Authority of India
q0018.f: ISRO and AAI developed GAGAN. CNES-DLR is the IDEFIX rover pair, and Pixxel-Sarvam is the orbital-computing collaboration. (PDF p. 121; issue context.)

q0019.s: How does the source classify Artemis II?
q0019.f: The article explicitly calls it a crewed lunar flyby to test systems for travel beyond low Earth orbit and safe return, not a Moon landing. (PDF p. 123; issue context.)

q0020.s: PFBR's first criticality most directly means what in the article?
o: All future reactors are commercially operational
The reactor produces no chain reaction
A sustained nuclear chain reaction has begun
q0020.f: The page defines the criticality milestone as initiating a sustained chain reaction and gives capacity as 500 MWe (electrical). It does not equate that milestone with full commercial operation. (PDF p. 129; issue context.)

q0021.s: Which caveat accompanies the issue's 58.4 versus 58.5 GtCO₂e comparison?
o: A permanent emissions peak is proven
Land use is the only emission source
Uncertainty prevents confirming a decline or peak
q0021.f: The article explicitly retains uncertainty. The values are global totals in gigatonnes CO₂-equivalent, not per-person values. (PDF p. 144; issue context.)

q0022.s: Which map pair is printed for Sauj Lake?
q0022.f: The map lists Sauj Lake (Mainpuri) under Uttar Pradesh. Surha Tal is the separate Ballia-related entry in the one-liners. (PDF p. 145; issue context.)

q0023.s: Which sequence matches COP30's action cycle in the issue?
q0023.f: The article gives Coordinate → Measure → Showcase → Scale. The order moves from organising action to tracking, displaying and expanding it. (PDF p. 156; issue context.)

q0024.s: What baseline belongs to the source's Belém 4x sustainable-fuels target for 2035?
q0024.f: The pledge seeks a fourfold increase by 2035 relative to 2024. Baseline and target year are essential parts of the statement. (PDF p. 156; issue context.)

q0025.s: Which UP paddy MSP pair is printed for the 2026-27 policy?
q0025.f: The paddy pair is ₹2,441 and ₹2,461 per quintal. The other figures on the page concern maize/bajra and jowar, so crop labels matter. (PDF p. 157; issue context.)

q0026.s: Which venue-event pair appears in the UP chapter?
o: Namo Ghat, Varanasi - Wings Over Ganga
q0026.f: Wings Over Ganga is the Varanasi air show at Namo Ghat. Bhadohi is the separate India Carpet Expo location. (PDF p. 157; issue context.)

q0027.s: What is the source's UP fiscal-deficit target for FY 2026-27?
q0027.f: The State fiscal deficit is 3% of GSDP. 1.6% is the revenue-surplus ratio and 1.2% the primary-deficit ratio; 4.3% is the Union figure in another chapter. (PDF p. 165; issue context.)

q0028.s: Which figure is net per-capita income in the UP survey for FY 2024-25?
q0028.f: ₹1,09,844 is net per-capita income; ₹1,26,304 is gross. ₹76,490 and ₹69,321 belong to Bihar's per-capita GSDP and NSDP figures. (PDF p. 168; issue context.)

q0029.s: Which statement preserves the source's Bihar digital-infrastructure stages?
o: Both projects are operational at 150 MW
The Patna centre is only a letter of intent
Bodh Gaya's 12 MW factory is completed
Patna has 12 MW initial IT load; Bodh Gaya's 150 MW AI factory is proposed under an LoI
q0029.f: The article separates an inaugurated Patna data centre from a proposed Bodh Gaya project. Keep location, capacity and stage together. (PDF p. 169; issue context.)

q0030.s: How are the detailed Bihar MSME targets/incentives qualified on p. 169?
q0030.f: The note explicitly says the details are from the July 2026 draft. The guide retains that qualifier instead of presenting every incentive as final. (PDF p. 169; issue context.)

q0031.s: What period belongs to Saat Nischay-3 in the source?
q0031.f: Saat Nischay-3 covers 2025-2030. The 2023-2028 period belongs to the separate Fourth Agriculture Roadmap. (PDF p. 175; issue context.)

q0032.s: Which growth pair is reported for Bihar FY 2024-25 quick estimates?
q0032.f: The Bihar survey gives 8.6% at constant 2011-12 prices and 13.1% at current prices. The estimate status and price basis must accompany the figures. (PDF p. 176; issue context.)

q0033.s: Who is credited with PMO: Prime Minister's Office Through the Years?
q0033.f: Himanshu Roy is credited as PMO's author. Vinod Rai is the editor of When Audit Matters and P.P. Sathyan wrote The Library Man of India. (PDF p. 220; issue context.)

q0034.s: Which naval exercise-partner pair matches the source table?
q0034.f: SLINEX pairs India with Sri Lanka. VARUNA pairs India with France and SIMBEX with Singapore; similar naval settings do not make the partners interchangeable. (PDF p. 213; issue context.)

q0035.s: Which contribution is associated with Toby Kiers in the issue?
o: An autobiography of a former President
q0035.f: The Tyler Prize entry recognises Toby Kiers for research on underground fungal networks. The award's environmental field helps distinguish it from books and exercises. (PDF p. 203; issue context.)

q0036.s: Which dated judicial succession is reported in the issue?
o: Surya Kant succeeded B.R. Gavai as 53rd CJI
B.R. Gavai succeeded Surya Kant as 53rd CJI
q0036.f: The appointment list records Surya Kant's oath as the 53rd Chief Justice on 24 November 2025 after B.R. Gavai. Keep the ordinal, succession and date together. (PDF p. 182; issue context.)

q0037.s: Which host pair belongs to the issue's 2026 ICC Men's T20 World Cup?
q0037.f: India and Sri Lanka host the men's T20 event. England-Wales is the women's T20 event and Zimbabwe-Namibia the men's U-19 event. (PDF p. 222; issue context.)

q0038.s: Which mascot-event pair is printed correctly?
q0038.f: Finnie is the Commonwealth Games unicorn; Honohon belongs to Aichi-Nagoya. Clutch is the USA FIFA mascot. (PDF p. 237; issue context.)

q0039.s: Which team/match expansion describes the 2026 men's FIFA World Cup in the issue?
q0039.f: The issue gives 48 teams and 104 matches for FIFA 2026. The other figures describe earlier FIFA format or different cricket tournaments. (PDF p. 238; issue context.)

q0040.s: Which future Olympic host pair appears in the source?
q0040.f: The future-events list pairs Los Angeles with the 2028 Olympics and Brisbane with 2032. Doha and Riyadh are Asian Games hosts in separate years. (PDF p. 239; issue context.)
